basics.name: Alex Mercer
basics.label: Senior Full Stack & Distributed Systems Engineer
basics.summary: Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing high-throughput microservices, cloud infrastructure, and responsive web applications. Specialized in Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, React, Kubernetes, and distributed event-driven systems handling 50M+ daily requests.

work.name: CloudScale Technologies
work.summary: Lead engineer on the real-time stream processing platform and multi-tenant data ingest API.
highlights: Architected asynchronous ingestion pipeline using FastAPI, Apache Kafka, and PostgreSQL, scaling throughput from 10K to 85K events/sec with sub-50ms latency.
Reduced cloud infrastructure costs by 32% ($140K/yr) by optimizing Kubernetes pod autoscaling and container memory footprint.
Mentored team of 6 engineers and spearheaded automated CI/CD migration to GitHub Actions, cutting release deployment cycle times by 45%.

work.name: Nexus Fintech Labs
work.summary: Core backend engineer for merchant payment processing engine and fraud detection pipeline.
highlights: Built resilient REST APIs and webhook delivery service in Python and Redis handling $12M daily transaction volume with 99.99% uptime.
Implemented real-time anomaly detection heuristics, reducing fraudulent transaction attempts by 28%.
Developed reusable React and TypeScript merchant dashboard components adopted by 15,000+ business customers.

projects.name: AsyncQuery: High Performance Cache Engine
projects.description: Open-source distributed in-memory cache written in Python with Redis-compatible protocol.
highlights: Gained 1,200+ GitHub stars and over 50,000 downloads on PyPI.
Benchmarked 30% higher read throughput compared to standard Python cache wrappers.
